_notes: Curated clean press for an investor-facing site. Articles with low ratings (1/5, 1.5/5, 2/5), tabloid framings (BLAST, TORTURING, drivel, tedious), shelved-film stories, vanity/bragging anecdotes, protest/controversy stories, and aggregator pages exposing scores have been removed. Films with fewer than 3 high-quality articles have their press section dropped — the External Resources block (IMDb + Full Credits + YouTube trailer) carries the load instead.
